name: write_logic
summary: Write one logic value to a device, by logic type name or number, as a chip or console would. Answers the value read back at once.

help.text: Returns requested_value, previous_value and current_value, read back at once: the device can clamp it (On 7 reads 1), ignore it (a colour index only paint sets) or move toward it over time (a solar panel turning); the write still succeeds. driven_by, present only when a controller writes the same logic type on the device, lists them ({kind, reference_id, logic_type, via, line}); one may write the value back. A write that opens a vent, valve, pump or regulator (On or Open from 0 to 1, a vent's Mode from inward to outward, a turbo pump's Mode turned, a volume pump's Setting from 0) first runs the write lint rules on the pipe networks it opens to, as they stand, every time (see lint); one that opens nothing runs none. A problem refuses it as lint_refused (data: each rule, message and thing) unless allow_lint; warnings come back in warnings [{code, message, index, reference_id}], absent when none. A report (dry_run) answers {report_only, problems, gateway_id, reference_id, logic_type, requested_value, previous_value, opens, warnings, driven_by} and writes nothing (see report_only).

logic_type.description: A logic type name (Temperature) or number.

value.description: The value to write: a finite number.

allow_lint.description: Default false: a write that opens a device onto a network a write lint rule finds a problem on is refused (lint_refused); true writes, each problem a warning.

dry_run.description: Default false. true checks the write, the write lint rules included, and writes nothing; the reply starts report_only (see report_only).
